description: For a dynaset, a table-type, a snapshot and a forward-only recordset over F opened with dbAppendOnly (8): read Type, Updatable, BOF, EOF and RecordCount; AddNew, assign ID (20, 21, 22, 23 in turn) and N 200, Update, read EditMode, BOF, EOF, RecordCount and ID; MoveFirst and read BOF, EOF and ID; Edit, Delete, Errors; close. Then a plain dynaset over F: walk ID and N. Asks what an append-only recordset exposes, whether AddNew works, whether Edit and Delete are refused, and what the base table then holds. The fixture copy is opened read-write.
retentionNote: Designed r-cursor-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
